rows.grounds: locative plural of sahasra, expressing multitude
compound yoni+yantra in locative plural, denoting realms or devices of birth
past passive participle describing those afflicted

items.question: What scale of torment afflicts beings within the womb-mechanisms?
premises: The quantity specified is eighty-four thousand.
items.inference: Beings suffer torment across eighty-four thousand womb-mechanisms.
uncertainties: The subject of pīḍitāḥ is implied from context rather than explicitly stated in this verse.
items.plain_english: They are tormented in the eighty-four thousand womb-mechanisms.
